# Yahoo News Australia

> Australia's leading news aggregator delivering breaking headlines, politics, sports, and international coverage with local expertise.

Yahoo News Australia provides comprehensive coverage of Australian and international news, with dedicated sections for politics, sports (AFL, NRL, cricket, tennis, football), environment, and lifestyle. The platform aggregates content from major sources including the Australian Associated Press and NewsWire, serving Australian readers with timely updates on elections, breaking news, and major sporting events.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Australian Politics
- Labor Party
- Elections
- AFL
- NRL
- Cricket
- Tennis
- Football/Premier League
- South Australia
- Environment & Climate
- Invasive Species
- Weather Alerts
- Sports Scores & Results
- Local Stories

## News & Breaking Updates

- [Australian News Headlines | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com): Yahoo News Australia homepage with breaking news and local stories.
- [Australian News | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/australia): Australian news section covering politics, elections, and breaking updates.
- [International News | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/world): International news aggregator with BBC, Independent, and global coverage.

## Politics & Government

- [Politics News | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/politics): Politics section covering elections, Labor, Liberal, and government policy.
- [Labor victorious as One Nation claw Liberal vote away](https://au.news.yahoo.com/historic-election-parties-race-secure-163000586.html): Labor wins South Australia election as One Nation damages Liberal vote.

## Sports Coverage

- [Australian Sports News, Latest AFL, NRL, Tennis, Cricket, Football and Global Sports | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport): Sports hub covering AFL, NRL, cricket, tennis, and international sports.
- [Latest AFL Australian Football League Updates, News, Scores, Rumours, Video and Results | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport/afl): AFL news section featuring match results, player injuries, and team transfers.
- [Latest NRL National Rugby League Updates, News, Scores, Rumours, Video and Results | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport/nrl): NRL news section with match results, player updates, and rugby league coverage.
- [Latest Cricket Updates, News, Scores, Rumours, Video and Results | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport/cricket): Cricket news covering Australian cricket, IPL, T20, and test matches.
- [Latest Tennis Updates, News, Scores, Rumours, Video and Results | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport/tennis): Tennis news covering ATP, WTA, Grand Slams, and player rankings.
- [Latest Football Updates, News, Scores, Rumours, Video and Results | Yahoo News Australia](https://au.news.yahoo.com/sport/football): Football news covering Premier League, Champions League, and transfer rumors.
